user.title: PGST Zone Manager
user.description: Select the existing PGST event entity from tuya-local.

init.title: Select zone
init.description: Choose an existing zone to edit, or add a zone.

edit.title: Configure zone {zone}
edit.description: Changes take effect when the integration reloads. The initial state is only used when configuring a toggle contact; use the correction service for later adjustments.

panel.title: Observe panel arm/disarm transitions
panel.description: Optional read-only observation. A disarm transition does not establish which remote operated the panel. Do not directly unlock a door based on this sensor.
